bioMarkdown:
Hi, I'm Junjie Wu. I received my B.Eng. in Computer Science and Technology and M.Eng. in Electronic Information from Tianjin University (TJU), advised by Prof. [Qilong Wang](https://csqlwang.github.io/homepage/) in the Machine Learning and Data Mining Laboratory.

My research focuses on **multimodal large language models**, **visual representation learning**, **domain-specific post-training**, **agentic reasoning**, and **AIGC and real-time video generation**. During my master's study, I worked on higher-order visual representations for Vision Transformers, domain-specific vision-language pre-training, and efficient visual token aggregation and compression for MLLMs. As a remote research assistant at HKUST (Guangzhou), advised by Prof. Yongqi Zhang, I developed VIGIL for causal visual-evidence analysis and LiveSearchVQA for certifying search necessity in multimodal web-search agents.

I have first-author or co-first-author publications at ICLR 2025, ICCV 2025, and ICMR 2026, with VIGIL and LiveSearchVQA in preparation for ICLR 2027. I am currently an Algorithm Researcher at Witmani, working on multi-agent content-generation harnesses and real-time emotional-avatar video generation; previously, I built domain-specific multimodal models at Glority.

Beyond research, I enjoy exploring emerging technologies and staying close to fast-moving ideas. I also love sports, especially basketball (captain of the Tianjin University basketball team, 2021-2023) and tennis.
blogTagline: Notes on multimodal learning, agentic systems, and generative video.
